products.name: Comet ML
products.note: ML experiment management; model monitoring; production tracking; team collaboration

profile_text.body:
Comet describes itself as an AI developer platform and the creator of Opik, which it presents as an end-to-end AI observability platform for developers covering agent testing, optimization, and monitoring. Opik provides LLM tracing across complex generative AI systems, including context retrieval, tool selection, and user feedback scoring, and supports instrumentation through more than 60 integrations. The platform also offers evaluation capabilities using more than 40 LLM-as-a-judge metrics, test suites with pass/fail results, and golden datasets, as well as production dashboards, alerting, and cost tracking for coding agents including visibility into Claude Code and Codex usage through a feature called Cost Intelligence.

Alongside Opik, Comet offers an experiment management product, tracked on this site as Comet ML, which provides model versioning, dataset management, custom visualizations, production monitoring, and hyperparameter tracking intended to make models explainable and reproducible. Both products are described as requiring only a few lines of code to instrument. Comet also notes the availability of an MCP server that can give coding agents access to observability information directly.
